images.caption: U.S. Air Force Senior Master Sgt. Esteban Rodriguez, a loadmaster from the 729th Airlift Squadron, March Air Reserve Base, Calif., secures cargo loaded onto a C-17 Globemaster III before a mission in support of Haiti earthquake relief efforts at Langley Air Force Base, Va., Jan. 16, 2010. The aircraft is carrying humanitarian aid along with U.S. Army Soldiers and equipment from the 688th Rapid Port Opening Element, Fort Eustis, Va. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Jacob N. Bailey)

images.caption: U.S. Air Force Col. John J. Allen Jr., 633rd Air Base Wing commander, presents Chief Master Sgt. Trae King, 633 ABW command chief, a letter from President Barack Obama during her retirement ceremony at Langley Air Force Base, Va., Jan. 23, 2015. During her 3-year tour at Langley, King advised two commanders and mentored more than 6,000 Service members. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Antoinette Gibson/Released)
images.alt: U.S. Air Force Col. John J. Allen Jr., 633rd Air Base Wing commander, presents Chief Master Sgt. Trae King, 633 ABW command chief, a letter from President Barack Obama during her retirement ceremony at Langley Air Force Base, Va., Jan. 23, 2015. During her 3-year tour at Langley, King advised two commanders and mentored more than 6,000 Service members. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Antoinette Gibson/Released)
images.artist: Staff Sgt. Antoinette Gibson, U.S. Air Force

images.caption: U.S. Air Force Col. John J. Allen Jr., 633rd Air Base Wing commander, presents Chief Master Sgt. Trae King, 633 ABW command chief, with a collage during her retirement ceremony at Langley Air Force Base, Va., Jan. 23, 2015. King is known for her ‘Lead-Out-Loud’ style of leadership which highlights the importance of the five “R”s; being ready, resilient, reliable, relevant and resourceful. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Antoinette Gibson/Released)
